### Notes

Could not inspect: benefit amount, duration, eligibility, and application terms. The form page at forms.supabase.com/supabasedeal is a JavaScript-only shell — the only server-rendered text is the heading "Supabase Startup Deal Application Form". https://supabase.com/solutions/startups is a product marketing page with no credits program, no amounts, and no application. https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/credits documents only self-serve credit top-ups (max $2000 per top-up), not a startup program. https://supabase.com/startups and https://supabase.com/startup-program both return 404. Third-party figures circulating for this program are not traceable to any Supabase page and were deliberately not recorded.
